# UK Bangla Tigers Cricket Club

> UK Bangla Tigers Cricket Club (UKBT) — international T20 cricket since
> 2020, an institute for learning. Sister franchise: Uppsala Tigers (Sweden).

- Homepage: https://ukbanglatigers.co.uk/
- About: https://ukbanglatigers.co.uk/about/
